title: Toilet Paper Please
description:
In Toilet Paper, please! you are a Toilet Paper Roll who wants to collect all the pieces of toilet paper in the world.

Face more than 100 levels in this challenging game.

Actually, there is no so much to say, to complete the game you have to collect every single piece of toilet paper in the level
before the time runs out, and without getting hit by the dangerous poops and obstacles around the level.

Use all the powerups you can to defeat the pooh or to restore your health

And last, but not least, destroy all the Big Bosses you will find at the end of each world. 
There are seven of them, and they are pretty angry!

What are you waiting for?

Let your journey in the bathrooms around the world begins!

You can do it! I know you can, and you know it too

The game features:
 
• -105 Levels

• - 7 different worlds

• - a lot of different powerups

• - 7 Final bosses
description_short: In Toilet Paper, please! you are a Toilet Paper Roll who wants to collect all the pieces of toilet paper in the world. Face more the 100 levels in this classic but challenging avoid and collect game.
